description: A `ref` variable names whichever run it holds when the end is taken. The Switcher (r3) holds Inventories r1 (`a`) and r2 (`b`) and watches `current`, which starts as `a` and is set to `b` by Swap. After Swap, r1 closes: its end comes from a run no address of an `ended` trigger names, so it is dropped. Then r2 closes, and `on current.ended` takes its end.
